snippet.title: Shard Squad - Launch Trailer EN | US
snippet.description:
Form a squad of elemental creatures and face hordes of challenging enemies! Choose your Shards according to their synergies to gain new abilities, and equip relics that will make the winds blow in your favor! Survive through different environments and save your lands!

Play Shard Squad now!
